description: Interview by an unidentified young man, March 16, 1993, with corrections in Maria Chabot's hand. Interview by Marion Wood, July 29, 1990, with corrections in MC's hand; a letter from Wood to MC; and note by MC [This interview, notes on a conversation, concerned MC's involvement in building O'Keeffe's house in Abiquiu.] Interview by Mary Thelma, May 1999 transcript of a taped interview primarily concerning events in 1940 with a note from Mary Thelma and a card from her daughter [There is an audiocassette of the interview in the oral histories series.]
title: Interviews with Maria Chabot
